purpose: Mandatory synchronization-impact declaration for future feature implementation passes.
rule: Every newly implemented or materially expanded domain must classify each synchronization plane as REGISTER_HOOK or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_EVIDENCE; silence is not acceptance.

planes.question: Which existing/new domain owns each fact and mutation?
planes.required: one canonical owner; no UiState/catch-all synchronization persistence

planes.question: Does current src_64 lazily/periodically/bootstrap-read this domain?
planes.required: register/extend hydration contract/provider and presentation/single-flight policy only when source-backed; bootstrap remains exact allow-list

planes.question: Does a mutation require economy_, new_funcs_, or generic Mission/BattlePass redmarks_?
planes.required: stage typed semantic dirtiness through UoW; do not hand-edit global response envelopes

planes.question: Does current client expose a badge/redmark for this domain?
planes.required: derive from canonical state; generic redmarks_ stays Mission/BattlePass unless new current-source evidence explicitly broadens it

planes.question: Is the read surface implemented while gameplay remains fenced?
planes.required: exact-MID read-only adapter + startup mutation-fence proof; remove/replace adapter when canonical domain implementation takes over

planes.question: Does the feature own durable user preferences such as MessagePush?
planes.required: canonical domain preference service + source-shaped serializer; never conflate preference mutation with realtime delivery

planes.question: Does committed state need transient notice/invalidation/chat delivery?
planes.required: domain-owned typed event/notice schema + explicit audience/role + stage realtime.transient only after canonical mutation; publisher owns no business state

planes.question: Must notification/reward delivery survive disconnect/restart?
planes.required: domain-owned durable outbox/receipt semantics (e.g. Commerce/Mail); never use transient realtime publisher as durable queue

planes.question: Does feature alter region/guild/room membership or authenticated identity?
planes.required: reuse canonical identity/RealtimeRoomAdmissionPolicy; no parallel account/session/room authority

planes.question: Does stock-client reconciliation require a patch?
planes.required: server/source-shape correction first; networking-core client patches remain measured last-mile evidence-gated

planes.question: What synchronization acceptance gates can this feature affect?
planes.required: rerun directly affected Wave A-F tests + controlling lower foundations; add cross-user leakage/restart/response-loss tests where applicable

examples.Mail: canonical durable mailbox + optional typed notice/invalidation + domain-owned durable delivery; do not move rewards into realtime
examples.Guild: canonical guild state + guild room admission facts + replace deferred MID1152 adapter when implemented + typed guild notices if source-backed
examples.Chat: domain chat schema/routing on authenticated transport; transport remains session infrastructure, not chat history owner
examples.Store: Economy/Commerce settlement + global economy semantics; realtime only if current source proves push/invalidation
examples.Arena_PvP: canonical domain state + typed notices/refresh invalidation + cross-user concurrency tests before live multi-user expansion
